Eigen (https://eigen.tuxfamily.org) is licensed under the Mozilla Public
License 2.0 (MPL2). See https://www.mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/

This directory vendors a trimmed copy of the Eigen/ header-only linear
algebra library (Core, LU, Cholesky, QR, SVD, Geometry, Eigenvalues,
Householder, Jacobi + the dense OrderingMethods used by them). The
sparse-matrix solver backends (Cholmod/KLU/Pardiso/PaStiX/SPQR/SuperLU/
UmfPack/Metis support) were removed since this project only uses dense
matrices -- if you need those, re-copy the Eigen/ directory from
https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen unmodified.
